scenario: A Lambda function processes images and sometimes runs out of time after 3 seconds. What should the developer change first?

options.text: Add more reserved concurrency to the function
Move the image library into a Lambda layer
options.note: Layers share code; they don't change limits.

explanation: The default timeout is 3 seconds; the maximum is 15 minutes. More memory also adds CPU.

scenario: A Lambda function's CPU-bound code is slow. Which setting most directly gives it more CPU?
explanation: Lambda allocates CPU in proportion to memory (up to 10,240 MB).

scenario: Which DynamoDB operation retrieves items using the partition key efficiently?
explanation: Scans are expensive; design keys to support Query patterns.

scenario: An app must query a DynamoDB table by an attribute that isn't the partition key, using a different partition key. What should be added?

options.text: A local secondary index (LSI) on the attribute
options.note: Same partition key; must be created with the table.

options.text: DynamoDB Streams with a Lambda filter

explanation: GSIs can be added any time and have their own throughput.

scenario: How many read capacity units are needed for 10 strongly consistent reads per second of 4 KB items?

options.note: Counts KB instead of 4 KB units.

explanation: 1 RCU = one strongly consistent read per second of up to 4 KB (or two eventually consistent reads).

scenario: How many write capacity units are needed for 5 writes per second of 3 KB items?
explanation: 1 WCU = one write per second of up to 1 KB; 3 KB items need 3 WCUs each.

scenario: Two users may update the same DynamoDB item at once. How can the app prevent one overwriting the other?

options.text: Use conditional writes with a version attribute
Run a Scan before every write to check for changes
Disable auto scaling on the table

explanation: This is optimistic locking; the DynamoDB Enhanced Client supports it.

scenario: Which service adds a microsecond-latency in-memory cache specifically for DynamoDB?
explanation: DAX is API-compatible with DynamoDB.

scenario: Which caching strategy loads data into the cache only when there's a cache miss?

options.note: Writes to cache on every update.

explanation: Lazy loading can serve stale data; add a TTL to limit staleness.

scenario: A web app must let users upload files directly to a private S3 bucket without AWS credentials. What should it use?

options.text: Presigned URLs generated by the backend
A bucket policy allowing public PutObject
S3 static website hosting with an index page

explanation: Presigned URLs expire and are limited to one object and method.

scenario: When should multipart upload be used for S3?

options.text: For large objects; it's required above 5 GB

options.note: Parts must be at least 5 MB, except the last.

options.text: Only when uploading to S3 Glacier storage classes

explanation: AWS recommends multipart for objects over 100 MB.

scenario: Which SQS setting reduces empty responses and cost when polling a queue?
explanation: Long polling waits for messages instead of returning immediately.

scenario: A consumer takes longer to process an SQS message than the visibility timeout. What happens?

options.text: The message becomes visible and may be processed twice
The message is moved straight to the dead-letter queue

explanation: Increase the timeout or call ChangeMessageVisibility; make consumers idempotent.

scenario: Orders must be processed exactly once and in the order sent. Which queue type fits?
explanation: FIFO queues use message group IDs for ordering and deduplication IDs.

scenario: One event must be delivered to several SQS queues for different services. What pattern fits?

options.text: SNS fan-out to subscribed SQS queues
One queue polled by all services
A single queue with message filtering
options.note: Each message is still consumed once.

explanation: EventBridge rules can also route one event to multiple targets.

scenario: Which service coordinates multiple Lambda functions in a workflow with retries and branching?
explanation: Express workflows suit high-volume, short-duration jobs.

scenario: Which service routes events from AWS services and SaaS apps to targets using rules?
explanation: EventBridge Scheduler can also invoke targets on a schedule.

scenario: A Lambda function reading from an SQS queue should send failed messages aside after several tries. What should be configured?

options.text: A dead-letter queue with a redrive policy
A Lambda destination for on-success events

explanation: For async invocations, Lambda destinations can also route failures.

scenario: Which API Gateway feature caches responses to reduce backend calls?
explanation: Cache TTL can be tuned; clients may invalidate with Cache-Control if allowed.

scenario: Clients receive HTTP 429 errors from API Gateway. What does this mean?

options.text: The API key in the header is malformed
The resource path doesn't exist on the API

explanation: Use exponential backoff with jitter on retries.

scenario: Which Kinesis Data Streams component determines which shard a record goes to?
explanation: Hot partition keys can overload a single shard.

scenario: A developer needs ordered processing of changes made to a DynamoDB table. What should they use?

options.text: DynamoDB Streams with a Lambda trigger
A GSI on the updated attribute

explanation: Streams keep changes for 24 hours in order per item.

scenario: Which Lambda feature shares common libraries across multiple functions?
explanation: A function can use up to five layers.

scenario: What's the best way to keep database connections efficient for many concurrent Lambda functions using RDS?

options.text: Open a new connection per request

explanation: RDS Proxy pools and shares connections.

scenario: Where should a Lambda function initialize SDK clients so they're reused across invocations?

options.text: Inside the handler on every call

explanation: Execution environments are reused while warm.

scenario: Which DynamoDB API writes several items across tables as an all-or-nothing operation?
explanation: Transactions cost twice the capacity of standard writes.

scenario: Which feature automatically deletes expired DynamoDB items at no write cost?
explanation: TTL uses a timestamp attribute in epoch seconds.

scenario: Which Cognito component exchanges tokens for temporary AWS credentials to call S3 directly?
explanation: User pools authenticate; identity pools authorize access to AWS resources.

scenario: Which ElastiCache write strategy keeps the cache always up to date with the database?
explanation: Write-through can cache data that's never read.

scenario: A Lambda function's code must write large temporary files during processing. Where should it write them?

options.text: The /tmp directory, sized as needed up to 10 GB

explanation: Use EFS or S3 for data that must persist.

scenario: An app on EC2 needs to call DynamoDB. What's the most secure way to provide credentials?

options.text: An IAM role attached through an instance profile
Access keys in a config file

explanation: Roles provide temporary credentials that rotate automatically.

scenario: Which API call lets an application get temporary credentials for another role?
explanation: Cross-account access commonly uses AssumeRole.

scenario: A Lambda function must read from S3 and write to DynamoDB. Where are these permissions defined?
explanation: The resource-based policy allows services like API Gateway or S3 to invoke the function.

scenario: Which KMS approach encrypts large data locally using a data key protected by a KMS key?

options.text: Calling Encrypt on the entire file
Applying an S3 bucket policy with encryption conditions

explanation: The encrypted data key is stored with the data.

scenario: Which service stores database credentials and can rotate them automatically?
explanation: Parameter Store SecureString parameters are encrypted with KMS but don't rotate automatically.

scenario: Which API Gateway authorizer validates JWTs from a Cognito user pool without custom code?

options.text: API keys in a usage plan

explanation: HTTP APIs support JWT authorizers natively.

scenario: Which API Gateway option lets the developer run custom logic to authorize requests with a bearer token?
explanation: Lambda authorizers return an IAM policy and can cache results.

scenario: Which S3 encryption option gives an audit trail of key usage in CloudTrail?

options.note: Keys managed by S3, no per-key audit.

explanation: SSE-KMS calls are logged; S3 Bucket Keys reduce KMS request costs.

scenario: A browser app on example.com gets errors calling an S3 bucket's objects with JavaScript. What should be configured?

options.text: A CORS configuration on the bucket
S3 Object Lock in governance mode

explanation: CORS allows cross-origin requests from specified domains.

scenario: How should a Lambda function store sensitive environment variables?

options.text: Encrypt them with a KMS key and decrypt at run time
Store them in plain text in the code
Put them in the function's description field
options.note: Visible to anyone who can view the function.

options.text: Save them in a public S3 bucket

explanation: Better still, fetch secrets from Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.

scenario: Which policy type is attached to an S3 bucket to allow access from another account?
explanation: Cross-account access needs both the bucket policy and the caller's IAM permissions.

scenario: In an IAM policy evaluation, what happens when one statement allows and another explicitly denies?
explanation: Everything is implicitly denied unless explicitly allowed.

scenario: A mobile app needs users to sign up and sign in with social providers like Google. Which service fits?

options.note: Doesn't scale; not for app users.

options.text: AWS Directory Service for Microsoft AD

explanation: User pools issue ID, access and refresh tokens.

scenario: Which token from a Cognito user pool should be sent to an API to access resources?
explanation: The ID token contains user identity claims.

scenario: Which service provides certificates for HTTPS on load balancers and CloudFront for free?
explanation: ACM renews public certificates automatically.

scenario: What's the purpose of an IAM permissions boundary?

options.text: Set the maximum permissions an identity can have
Log all API calls made by the identity

explanation: Boundaries let developers create roles safely within limits.

scenario: Which mechanism protects data in transit between a client and an API Gateway endpoint?
explanation: API Gateway endpoints are HTTPS only.

scenario: A developer must sign API requests to an IAM-authorized API Gateway endpoint. Which signing process is used?
explanation: AWS SDKs and the CLI sign requests automatically.

scenario: Which KMS feature automatically creates new key material on a schedule for a customer managed key?
explanation: The default period is one year and can be set from 90 to 2,560 days; old key material is kept so existing data can still be decrypted.

scenario: Which approach keeps API keys out of source code in a CI/CD pipeline?

options.text: Reference them from Secrets Manager or Parameter Store
Commit them to a private repo
Share them in the team's chat channel

explanation: CodeBuild can inject secrets as environment variables at build time.

scenario: Which IAM feature lets a container in ECS get its own permissions separate from the host?
explanation: The task execution role is used by ECS to pull images and write logs.

scenario: Why use temporary credentials instead of long-term access keys?

options.text: They expire, limiting damage if leaked
They're shorter and easier to copy

explanation: STS issues temporary credentials for roles and federated users.

scenario: Which S3 feature can block all public access settings at the account or bucket level?
explanation: Block Public Access is enabled by default on new buckets.

scenario: A developer must give a partner temporary download access to one S3 object. What's simplest?

options.text: Share a presigned URL with an expiration
Create an IAM user for the partner
Disable default encryption on the object

explanation: The URL inherits the permissions of the credentials that signed it.

scenario: Which KMS key type is fully managed by AWS for a service like S3, with no customer control of policies?
explanation: AWS managed keys have aliases like aws/s3.

scenario: Which file defines build commands for AWS CodeBuild?
explanation: Phases include install, pre_build, build and post_build.

scenario: Which file tells AWS CodeDeploy how to deploy an application and run lifecycle hooks?
explanation: Hooks include BeforeInstall, AfterInstall, ApplicationStart and ValidateService.

scenario: Which Lambda deployment preference shifts 10% of traffic first, then the rest after a set time?
explanation: Example: Canary10Percent5Minutes. CloudWatch alarms can trigger automatic rollback.

scenario: Which Elastic Beanstalk deployment policy launches a new set of instances and swaps them in only if healthy?
explanation: Immutable deployments roll back easily by terminating the new instances.

scenario: Which Elastic Beanstalk policy is fastest but causes downtime?
explanation: Use it for dev or test environments.

scenario: Which transform line identifies a CloudFormation template as an AWS SAM template?

options.note: A resource type, not a transform.

explanation: SAM simplifies functions, APIs and tables with resources like AWS::Serverless::Function.

scenario: Which SAM CLI command packages and deploys an application, prompting for settings the first time?
explanation: Run sam build first to prepare artifacts.

scenario: Which CloudFormation intrinsic function returns an attribute like a resource's ARN?
explanation: Ref returns the default value, often the resource name or ID.

scenario: How can one CloudFormation stack use a value output by another stack?

options.text: Export the output and use Fn::ImportValue
Copy the value manually each time
Use a Lambda layer to share the value

explanation: Nested stacks are another way to reuse templates.

scenario: Which CloudFormation feature previews changes before updating a stack?
explanation: Review replacements carefully, as some updates recreate resources.

scenario: Which Lambda feature lets an API always call the 'prod' version while new code is tested?

options.text: An alias pointing to a published version

explanation: Aliases can split traffic between two versions with weights.

scenario: A team wants to define infrastructure in TypeScript instead of YAML. Which tool fits?
explanation: CDK synthesizes CloudFormation templates.

scenario: Which service automates the full release pipeline from source to build to deploy?
explanation: Pipelines can include manual approval actions.

scenario: Where should Docker images for an ECS service be stored?
explanation: ECR supports image scanning and lifecycle policies.

scenario: Which API Gateway feature lets one API have dev, test and prod with different settings?
explanation: Stage variables can point to different Lambda aliases.

scenario: Which CodeDeploy deployment type for EC2 replaces instances with new ones behind the load balancer?
explanation: Blue/green allows fast rollback by rerouting traffic.

scenario: How can a developer test a Lambda function locally before deploying?

options.text: sam local invoke with a sample event

explanation: sam local start-api emulates API Gateway locally.

scenario: Which service manages feature flags and configuration changes with validation and gradual rollout?
explanation: AppConfig can roll back if a CloudWatch alarm fires.

scenario: Which Elastic Beanstalk file can customize the environment, such as installing packages?

options.note: Defines processes to run, not packages.

explanation: Platform hooks in .platform are used on Amazon Linux 2 and later.

scenario: Which CodeBuild feature speeds builds by keeping dependencies between runs?
explanation: Cache package manager directories like node_modules or .m2.

scenario: A Lambda deployment should automatically roll back if errors increase. What should be configured?
explanation: SAM's DeploymentPreference sets this up with a few lines.

scenario: Which service traces requests across microservices to find latency bottlenecks?
explanation: X-Ray builds a service map from trace segments.

scenario: In X-Ray, which data is indexed so it can be used to filter traces?
explanation: Use annotations for values you want to search, like customer ID.

scenario: An app on EC2 must send X-Ray traces. What must run on the instance?

options.text: The X-Ray daemon or the CloudWatch agent/ADOT collector
The SSM agent with Run Command

explanation: The instance role also needs permission to write traces.

scenario: Which feature publishes custom metrics from Lambda logs without extra API calls?
explanation: EMF turns structured log lines into metrics.

scenario: Which CloudWatch feature queries log data with a purpose-built query language?
explanation: Example: fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /ERROR/.

scenario: A DynamoDB table returns ProvisionedThroughputExceededException. What should the client do?

options.text: Retry immediately in a tight loop

explanation: Also consider on-demand capacity or better partition key design.

scenario: A DynamoDB table is throttled even with plenty of total capacity. What's the likely cause?
explanation: Choose high-cardinality partition keys to spread traffic.

scenario: Lambda functions start slowly after periods of no traffic. What reduces this?

options.text: A dead-letter queue for failed events

explanation: SnapStart can also reduce cold starts for supported runtimes.

scenario: Where can a developer see a Lambda function's print and log output?

options.text: An Amazon S3 bucket created by default

explanation: The execution role needs permission to write logs.

scenario: API Gateway returns HTTP 504 for a Lambda-backed endpoint. What's the likely cause?
explanation: Optimize the function or use asynchronous patterns for long work.

scenario: Which Lambda setting prevents one function from using all concurrency in the account?
explanation: Reserved concurrency also guarantees capacity for that function.

scenario: How can a developer reduce the cost of many small S3 GET requests for frequently read objects?
explanation: Caching reduces latency and origin requests.

scenario: Which CloudWatch metric resolution allows data points every 1 second?
explanation: High-resolution alarms can evaluate every 10 or 30 seconds.

scenario: An SQS consumer keeps failing on the same malformed message. How should this be handled?

options.text: Configure a DLQ with a maxReceiveCount
Increase the queue's retention to 14 days

explanation: Inspect DLQ messages and redrive them after fixing the bug.

scenario: Which tool helps find which part of Lambda code is slow by recording subsegments?
explanation: Wrap downstream calls to see their timing.

scenario: A Lambda function in a VPC can't reach the internet to call a third-party API. What's needed?

options.text: A NAT gateway route from its private subnets
A public IP on the function
options.note: Lambda ENIs don't get public IPs.

options.text: A VPC gateway endpoint for S3

explanation: Use VPC endpoints for AWS services to avoid NAT costs.

scenario: How can a developer make an idempotent API so retries don't create duplicate orders?

options.text: Use an idempotency key and conditional writes

explanation: Powertools for AWS Lambda includes an idempotency utility.
